notes: Use existing stable action IDs and route IDs for existing_action_assignments.
Keep new UI-only actions separate, with exact visible labels and native_command null until verified.
Each button decision includes its current use, proposed use or intentional empty state, reason, alternatives, conflicts and evidence status.
Distinguish an emitted key from a verified game action. A nonempty keycode is not useful-action coverage.

Apply the latest finger-specific policy after verifying geometry. Keep the bottom little-finger #37 empty unless explicitly requested; #1 WEAPONS, #2 infrequent action, #3 MENUS, #4 optional extra layer, #36 TOOLS unchanged.
Other buttons on the held layer's finger may remain empty and do not count as missing capacity. Review eligible accessible empty controls instead.

For each consequential user requirement, give its origin, expectation, implementation status, accepted/pending review, evidence_status and relevant evidence. External review cannot establish fresh machine or physical acceptance.
Each annotation separates observed facts, official mechanics, planning inference and unknown user frequency.
Return this review plus a short explanation. A local agent reconciles pins and supported workbook fields before any import.
Do not rewrite pinned sources, native outputs or installed files. This data grants no Apply or Publish authority.
